GET /subscription/public-pricing does not exist in production yet (it ships with E9.59 and needs an operator API-Gateway route), so there is nothing to capture. The FIELD SET is not guessed: betting_ml/tests/test_e9_59_public_pricing.py asserts these keys equal PublicPricing.model_fields exactly, so a backend shape change breaks the Python gate rather than drifting silently from this file. Replace with a real capture (npm run e2e:capture) once the route is live. The AMOUNT is deliberately 1234 ($12.34) rather than the real $10/$20: a page that hardcodes its price would still render a plausible number against a realistic fixture, and could not be caught. The api-mock strips this key before serving, so the payload the page receives is exactly the API's shape.
